info.title: CodeSage API
info.description:
Local-first, stateless AI pull request review assistant.

## Authentication
No user authentication. Configure `GitHub:PersonalAccessToken` and `OpenAI:ApiKey`
via user-secrets or environment variables.

## Errors
All failures return RFC 7807 `application/problem+json` with an `errorCode` extension.

## Versioning
Current surface is `/api/v1`. Breaking changes will ship as `/api/v2`.

get.description: Returns non-secret runtime configuration useful for clients and troubleshooting. API keys and tokens are never included — only whether they are configured.

400.description: Validation failed — RFC 7807 ProblemDetails with an errors object.

get.description: Returns process liveness. Does not probe GitHub or OpenAI. Safe for orchestrators and load balancers.

400.description: Validation failed — RFC 7807 ProblemDetails with an errors object.

get.description: Returns configuration readiness and optional connectivity probes. Never includes API keys or tokens. Disable probes with Application:ProbeExternalConnectivity=false.

400.description: Validation failed — RFC 7807 ProblemDetails with an errors object.

get.description: Lists pull requests for a repository (all states, recently updated first).
Returns pull request details including files, commits, and review/issue comments.
Builds a deterministic ReviewContext for the pull request. Does not call OpenAI. Pass the result to POST /api/v1/reviews for an AI review.
Lists repositories visible to the configured GitHub Personal Access Token (owned, collaborator, and organization memberships the token can see).

400.description: Validation failed — RFC 7807 ProblemDetails with an errors object.

get.description: Returns details for a single repository identified by owner and name.

post.description: Runs the configured OpenAI model against a ReviewContext and returns a structured ReviewReport. Stateless — nothing is persisted. Obtain a ReviewContext from GET .../pull-requests/{number}/analysis.

ChangedFileDto.description: A file changed in a pull request.

CodeLanguage.description:
Programming languages / formats CodeSage can classify in Stage 3.
Unknown and Binary are explicit so future AI providers can filter safely.

CommitSummaryDto.description: Commit summary associated with a pull request.

ConfigurationSummaryResponse.description: Public configuration summary for clients. Never includes secrets.

ConnectivityCheckResult.description: Result of an optional external connectivity probe.

FileChangeStatus.description: Normalized change status — independent of any source-control vendor vocabulary.

HealthResponse.description: Public health-check response contract returned by `GET /api/health`.

PullRequestCommentDto.description: Issue or review comment on a pull request.

PullRequestDetailsDto.description: Full pull request details including files, commits, and comments.

ReviewContext.description:
The only object future AI providers should consume.
Contains no GitHub / Octokit / vendor types — only CodeSage vocabulary.

ReviewReport.description: Structured review report — the only AI output the rest of CodeSage consumes.
ReviewReport.example: {"summary":"Solid incremental change with one auth edge case.","overallRisk":"Medium","positiveFindings":["Clear PR description"],"issues":[],"recommendations":["Add a regression test for the null token path"],"missingTests":["Auth failure path"],"securityConcerns":[],"performanceConcerns":[],"maintainability":[],"architectureConcerns":[],"model":"gpt-4o-mini","promptTokens":1200,"completionTokens":400,"totalTokens":1600,"duration":"00:00:02.1500000"}

ReviewRiskLevel.description: Overall risk level assigned by the model.

SystemStatusResponse.description: Local diagnostics for troubleshooting configuration (never includes secrets).
SystemStatusResponse.example: {"application":"CodeSage","version":"0.1.0","environment":"Development","aiProvider":"OpenAI","aiModel":"gpt-4o-mini","gitHubTokenConfigured":true,"openAiApiKeyConfigured":true,"gitHubConnectivity":{"status":"Skipped","message":"External probes disabled"},"openAiConnectivity":{"status":"Skipped","message":"External probes disabled"},"diagnostics":["Configuration looks ready for local reviews."]}
